'''Bait''' is used to reduce the delay before a nibble on a fishing rod by 50%.<ref name="fishbitetime" /> It can be purchased from the [[Fish Shop]] after reaching Fishing Level 2 for {{Price|5}} each, [[Crafting#Fishing|crafted]] after reaching Fishing Level 2, grown in a [[Worm Bin]], or found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]]. It may also randomly appear at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|1}}.

Bait cannot be used with the [[Training Rod]] or the [[Bamboo Pole]]. Only the [[Fiberglass Rod]], the [[Iridium Rod]], and the [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] can use bait. Bait can also be used with [[Crab Pot]]s.

==Dyeing==
Bait can be used as a red dye color in the [[Dyeing|dye pots]] in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Bait is not used in any [[quests]].

==Trivia==
*Prior to [[Version History#1.6|version 1.6]], thirty bait was the reward for completing the {{Bundle|River Fish||y}}.

==Tips==
*Levels 21-29 of [[The Mines]] and the [[Mutant Bug Lair]] are generally the best sources of [[Bug Meat|bug meat]] for players focusing on [[fishing]].
